hardware_used: NVIDIA GB10 (Grace-Blackwell, aarch64, 121.7 GB unified memory), 1 GPU
notes: Single ALIGNN 2.0 models (pure-PyTorch reimplementation), k-nearest-neighbor graph (8 A cutoff, 12 neighbors, full line graph). Published ALIGNN training recipe (lr 1e-3 one-cycle, batch 64, weight decay 1e-5, 4 ALIGNN + 4 GCN layers, 300 epochs, best-validation-checkpoint evaluation) with hidden width 768. Per property, the config was chosen on the validation split only over variants of the published recipe (hidden width 256/512/768; for optb88vdw_bandgap also EMA, learning rate, weight decay; for optb88vdw_total_energy also a formation-energy-tuned recipe and its width-768 combination). For the bandgaps, three torch-seed replicas of the selected width-768 config were trained and the validation-best replica is submitted: optb88vdw_bandgap torch_seed 231 (test MAE 0.12449 eV), mbj_bandgap torch_seed 312 (test MAE 0.25763 eV); optb88vdw_total_energy is a single run, torch_seed 123 (test MAE 0.02965 eV/atom). Trained on the exact benchmark splits (keep_data_order with the benchmark's train/val/test ordering).
